description: Event teaser briefs for social.event-teaser and social.event-days-teaser, including one without a date and one without a day count.

briefs.brief: Vertical teaser for Harbour Lights Festival, live music on Sat 12 July at Riverside Park, Bristol. Call to action: Get tickets
Countdown reel for Northside Makers Fair on 4 October at the Old Tram Depot, Leeds. It is 21 days away. Call to action: Register free
Hype video for the Valletta Rapid Chess Open, Sunday 3 May, 10am at Grand Harbour Hotel, Malta. Call to action: Enter now. Make it feel like a poster.
Make a hype countdown for our summer party at the beach club. Call to action: RSVP now
briefs.note: No date and no place; both are verbatim, so the writer must report them missing. ("summer party" may be taken as the name: verbatim grounding ignores case.)

briefs.brief: Countdown teaser for Riverside Book Fair on 2 May at City Library, Norwich. Call to action: Save the date
briefs.note: The brief never states how many days are left; days_to_go is verbatim and must be reported missing, never computed.
